rawSummary.p95Reason: Three independent repetitions do not justify a tail percentile

limitations: N=1 independent Chromium per triage; six ABC cycles inside one browser are not independent repetitions.

Real Store/DriveService/Auth/HTTP/backend only apply to their declared condition. Upload/download/coordination/dialog/transcoder dependencies remain controlled; thumbnail clear/prune operate on an empty synthetic signal.

Store is genuinely shared via DI, loaded before baseline and read for each playback. The Store file is enriched with forceOriginal/shareFdk, bypassing automatic proxy selection and private-vault FDK/name decryption.
Public backend DTO omits optional MIME; Store type remains unknown with the locked vault. The controlled Store DTO mirrors that shape; player is explicitly mounted for the known MP4 corpus.
A new common Angular app includes HTTP/router/Store code and is stabilized before baseline; the old R7 classification is never reused.
Corpus and native worker bytes exactly match R7-R2. R6 plaintext hashes differ; no strict historical quantitative comparison.
Original component is unmuted and retains its 500ms canplay interval; same autoplay flag and playback windows in every R8 condition.
Native counters are cumulative per ABC cycle; per-fixture playback/timing and pre-freeze individual MSE checks are supplied. No invented native per-fixture allocation trace.
Known ownership and process private commit do not establish zero native/VRAM allocation or absence of leaks.
Native PostgreSQL/backend run separately throughout the campaign; their memory is excluded from CDP-owned Chromium metrics.
The initial native processes ended across a user continuation before freeze; the same marker-verified owned cluster/storage/accounts were safely resumed, without changing corpus or IDs.
No confirmed leak, individual cause, universal bound, full-vault/proxy/navigation scenario or absence of growth is established.
